arabic_blocks: [135] حدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم الحنظلي قال: أخبرنا عبد الرزاق قال: أخبرنا معمر عن همام بن منبه أنه سمع أبا هريرة يقول:
قال رسول الله ﷺ: لا تقبل صلاة من أحدث حتى يتوضأ قال رجل من حضرموت ما الحدث يا أبا هريرة قال: فساء أو ضراط
english_blocks: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali related to us. He said: ‘Abd al-Razzaq informed us. He said: Ma‘mar informed us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, that he heard Abu Hurayrah saying:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “The prayer of someone in a state of hadath is not accepted until he performs ablution.” A man from Hadramawt said: “What is hadath, Abu Hurayrah?” He said: “Passing wind silently or audibly.”
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: The chain retains Ishaq’s full selected name, both “informed us” verbs and Hammam’s hearing of Abu Hurayrah. Both forms of passing wind in the answer remain. The term hadath is retained for the question and answer; no extra list of causes is inserted.

The historical print says “the Prophet” where the selected digital and modern print say “the Messenger of Allah”. The selected form is retained. The Khan-family comparison abbreviates the chain and does not distinguish the silent and audible forms in the answer.

english_blocks: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us. He said: Al-Layth related to us, from Khalid, from Sa‘id ibn Abi Hilal, from Nu‘aym al-Mujmir, who said:
I climbed onto the roof of the mosque with Abu Hurayrah. He performed ablution and said:

I heard the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, say: “My community will be called on the Day of Resurrection with radiant faces and limbs from the traces of ablution. So whoever among you can extend his radiance, let him do so.”

arabic_blocks: [138] حدثنا علي بن عبد الله قال: حدثنا سفيان عن عمرو قال: أخبرني كريب عن ابن عباس

أن النبي ﷺ نام حتى نفخ ثم صلى وربما قال اضطجع حتى نفخ ثم قام فصلى ثم حدثنا به سفيان مرة بعد مرة عن عمرو عن كريب عن ابن عباس قال بت عند خالتي ميمونة ليلة فقام النبي ﷺ من الليل فلما كان في بعض الليل قام النبي ﷺ فتوضأ من شن معلق وضوءا خفيفا يخففه عمرو ويقلله وقام يصلي فتوضأت نحوا مما توضأ ثم جئت فقمت عن يساره وربما قال سفيان عن شماله فحولني فجعلني عن يمينه ثم صلى ما شاء الله ثم اضطجع فنام حتى نفخ ثم أتاه المنادي فآذنه بالصلاة فقام معه إلى الصلاة فصلى ولم يتوضأ قلنا لعمرو إن ناسا يقولون إن رسول الله ﷺ تنام عينه ولا ينام قلبه قال عمرو سمعت عبيد بن عمير يقول رؤيا الأنبياء وحي ثم قرأ { إني أرى في المنام أني أذبحك }
english_blocks: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abdullah related to us. He said: Sufyan related to us, from ‘Amr, who said: Kurayb informed me, from Ibn ‘Abbas:
The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, slept until he snored, then prayed.
Sometimes he said: “He lay down until he snored, then got up and prayed.”
Then Sufyan related to us this report time after time, from ‘Amr, from Kurayb, from Ibn ‘Abbas, who said:

One night I stayed with my maternal aunt Maymunah. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, got up during the night. When part of the night had passed, the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, got up and performed a light ablution from a hanging worn waterskin.
‘Amr described it as light and small in amount.
He stood to pray. I performed ablution much as he had, then came and stood on his left.
Sometimes Sufyan said: “On his left.”

He moved me and placed me on his right. Then he prayed as much as Allah willed, then lay down and slept until he snored. Then the caller came and informed him of the prayer. He got up with him to go to the prayer, prayed, and did not perform ablution.

We said to ‘Amr: “Some people say that the eye of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sleeps, but his heart does not sleep.” ‘Amr said: “I heard ‘Ubayd ibn ‘Umayr say: ‘The dreams of the prophets are revelation.’” Then he recited: {I see in a dream that I am slaughtering you.}

arabic_blocks: [139] حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة عن مالك عن موسى بن عقبة عن كريب مولى ابن عباس عن أسامة بن زيد أنه سمعه يقول

دفع رسول الله ﷺ من عرفة حتى إذا كان بالشعب نزل فبال ثم توضأ ولم يسبغ الوضوء فقلت: الصلاة يا رسول الله، فقال الصلاة أمامك فركب فلما جاء المزدلفة نزل فتوضأ فأسبغ الوضوء ثم أقيمت الصلاة فصلى المغرب ثم أناخ كل إنسان بعيره في منزله ثم أقيمت العشاء فصلى ولم يصل بينهما
english_blocks: ‘Abdullah ibn Maslamah related to us, from Malik, from Musa ibn ‘Uqbah, from Kurayb, the client of Ibn ‘Abbas, from Usamah ibn Zayd, that he heard him say:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, set out from ‘Arafah. When he reached the mountain pass, he dismounted and urinated, then performed ablution without doing it thoroughly. I said: “The prayer, Messenger of Allah!” He said: “The prayer is ahead of you.” He mounted, and when he reached Muzdalifah he dismounted and performed ablution thoroughly. Then the prayer was announced and he prayed Maghrib. Then each person made his camel kneel at his stopping place. Then ‘Isha’ was announced and he prayed, and he did not pray between the two.

arabic_blocks: [140] حدثنا محمد بن عبد الرحيم قال: أخبرنا أبو سلمة الخزاعي منصور بن سلمة قال: أخبرنا ابن بلال يعني سليمان عن زيد بن أسلم عن عطاء بن يسار عن ابن عباس

أنه توضأ فغسل وجهه ثم أخذ غرفة من ماء فمضمض بها واستنشق ثم أخذ غرفة من ماء فجعل بها هكذا أضافها إلى يده الأخرى فغسل بهما وجهه ثم أخذ غرفة من ماء فغسل بها يده اليمنى ثم أخذ غرفة من ماء فغسل بها يده اليسرى ثم مسح برأسه ثم أخذ غرفة من ماء فرش على رجله اليمنى حتى غسلها ثم أخذ غرفة أخرى فغسل بها رجله يعني اليسرى، ثم قال هكذا رأيت رسول الله ﷺ يتوضأ
english_blocks: Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Rahim related to us. He said: Abu Salamah al-Khuza‘i, Mansur ibn Salamah, informed us. He said: Ibn Bilal—meaning Sulayman—informed us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from ‘Ata’ ibn Yasar, from Ibn ‘Abbas:

He performed ablution and washed his face. Then he took a handful of water and rinsed his mouth and drew water into his nose with it. Then he took a handful of water and did this with it: he added it to his other hand and washed his face with both. Then he took a handful of water and washed his right hand and arm with it. Then he took a handful of water and washed his left hand and arm with it. Then he wiped his head. Then he took a handful of water and sprinkled it on his right foot until he had washed it. Then he took another handful and washed his foot with it—meaning the left. Then he said: “This is how I saw the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, perform ablution.”

arabic_blocks: [141] حدثنا علي بن عبد الله قال: حدثنا جرير عن منصور عن سالم بن أبي الجعد عن كريب عن ابن عباس يبلغ به النبي ﷺ قال:

arabic_blocks: [142] حدثنا آدم قال: حدثنا شعبة عن عبد العزيز بن صهيب قال: سمعت أنسا يقول

كان النبي ﷺ إذا دخل الخلاء قال اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الخبث والخبائث تابعه بن عرعرة عن شعبة، وقال غندر عن شعبة إذا أتى الخلاء، وقال موسى عن حماد إذا دخل، وقال سعيد بن زيد حدثنا عبد العزيز إذا أراد أن يدخل
english_blocks: Adam related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us, from ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Suhayb, who said: I heard Anas saying:
When the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, entered the privy, he would say: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.”

Ibn ‘Ar‘arah followed him in transmitting this from Shu‘bah. Ghundar said, from Shu‘bah: “When he came to the privy.” Musa said, from Hammad: “When he entered.” Sa‘id ibn Zayd said: ‘Abd al-‘Aziz related to us: “When he wanted to enter.”

arabic_blocks: [145] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال: أخبرنا مالك عن يحيى بن سعيد عن محمد بن يحيى بن حبان عن عمه واسع بن حبان عن عبد الله بن عمر أنه كان يقول

إن ناسا يقولون إذا قعدت على حاجتك فلا تستقبل القبلة ولا بيت المقدس، فقال عبد الله بن عمر لقد ارتقيت يوما على ظهر بيت لنا فرأيت رسول الله ﷺ على لبنتين مستقبلا بيت المقدس لحاجته، وقال لعلك من الذين يصلون على أوراكهم فقلت لا أدري والله قال: مالك يعني الذي يصلي ولا يرتفع عن الأرض يسجد وهو لاصق بالأرض
english_blocks: ‘Abdullah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik informed us, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, from his uncle Wasi‘ ibn Habban, from ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Umar, who used to say:

Some people say: “When you sit down to relieve yourself, do not face the qiblah or Jerusalem.” ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Umar said: “One day I climbed onto the roof of a house of ours and saw the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, on two bricks, facing Jerusalem to relieve himself.” He said: “Perhaps you are among those who pray on their hips.” I said: “I do not know, by Allah.”
Malik said: He means someone who prays without raising himself from the ground, prostrating while pressed against the ground.

arabic_blocks: [146] حدثنا يحيى بن بكير قال: حدثنا الليث قال: حدثنا عقيل عن ابن شهاب عن عروة عن عائشة

أن أزواج النبي ﷺ كن يخرجن بالليل إذا تبرزن إلى المناصع وهو صعيد أفيح فكان عمر يقول للنبي ﷺ احجب نساءك فلم يكن رسول الله ﷺ يفعل فخرجت سودة بنت زمعة زوج النبي ﷺ ليلة من الليالي عشاء وكانت امرأة طويلة فناداها عمر ألا قد عرفناك يا سودة حرصا على أن ينزل الحجاب فأنزل الله آية الحجاب وحدثنا زكريا قال: حدثنا أبو أسامة عن هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عائشة عن النبي ﷺ قال: قد أذن أن تخرجن في حاجتكن قال هشام يعني البراز
english_blocks: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us. He said: Al-Layth related to us. He said: ‘Uqayl related to us, from Ibn Shihab, from ‘Urwah, from ‘A’ishah:

The wives of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to go out at night to relieve themselves at al-Manasi‘, a broad open plain. ‘Umar used to say to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “Veil your wives,” but the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, did not do so. One evening, Sawdah bint Zam‘ah, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out. She was a tall woman. ‘Umar called to her: “Indeed, we have recognised you, Sawdah!” He was eager for the hijab to be revealed, so Allah revealed the verse of hijab.
And Zakariyya related to us. He said: Abu Usamah related to us, from Hisham ibn ‘Urwah, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who said:
“You have been permitted to go out for your needs.”
Hisham said: He means relieving oneself.

english_blocks: Ya‘qub ibn Ibrahim related to us. He said: Yazid ibn Harun related to us. He said: Yahya informed us, from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habban, that his uncle Wasi‘ ibn Habban informed him that ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Umar informed him, saying:
One day I went up onto the roof of our house and saw the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sitting on two bricks, facing Jerusalem.

arabic_blocks:
[149] حدثنا أبو الوليد هشام بن عبد الملك قال: حدثنا شعبة عن أبي معاذ واسمه عطاء بن أبي ميمونة قال:
سمعت أنس بن مالك يقول كان النبي ﷺ إذا خرج لحاجته أجيء أنا وغلام معنا إداوة من ماء يعني يستنجي به
english_blocks: Abu al-Walid Hisham ibn ‘Abd al-Malik related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us, from Abu Mu‘adh, whose name is ‘Ata’ ibn Abi Maymunah, who said: I heard Anas ibn Malik saying:
When the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out to relieve himself, a boy and I would come with a small water vessel.
Meaning: he would cleanse himself with it.

The explanation “Meaning: he would cleanse himself with it” is retained without inventing a named speaker; the Khan-family comparison attributes it to Hisham.

كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا خرج لحاجته تبعته أنا وغلام منا معنا إداوة من ماء
english_blocks: Sulayman ibn Harb related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us, from Abu Mu‘adh—he is ‘Ata’ ibn Abi Maymunah—who said: I heard Anas saying:
When the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out to relieve himself, a boy from among us and I followed him, carrying a small water vessel.

arabic_blocks: [151] حدثنا محمد بن بشار قال: حدثنا محمد بن جعفر قال: حدثنا شعبة عن عطاء بن أبي ميمونة سمع أنس بن مالك يقول
كان رسول الله ﷺ يدخل الخلاء فأحمل أنا وغلام إداوة من ماء وعنزة يستنجي بالماء تابعه النضر وشاذان عن شعبة العنزة عصا عليه زج
english_blocks: Muhammad ibn Bashshar related to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja‘far related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us, from ‘Ata’ ibn Abi Maymunah, who heard Anas ibn Malik saying:
The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, would enter the privy, and a boy and I would carry a small water vessel and an ‘anazah. He would cleanse himself with the water.
Al-Nadr and Shadhan followed him in transmitting this from Shu‘bah. An ‘anazah is a staff with an iron tip.

arabic_blocks: [152] حدثنا معاذ بن فضالة قال: حدثنا هشام هو الدستوائي عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة عن أبيه قال:
قال رسول الله ﷺ: إذا شرب أحدكم فلا يتنفس في الإناء وإذا أتى الخلاء فلا يمس ذكره بيمينه ولا يتمسح بيمينه
english_blocks: Mu‘adh ibn Fadalah related to us. He said: Hisham—he is al-Dastawa’i—related to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from ‘Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “When one of you drinks, he should not breathe into the vessel. When he goes to the privy, he should not touch his penis with his right hand or wipe himself with his right hand.”

arabic_blocks: [153] حدثنا محمد بن يوسف قال: حدثنا الأوزاعي عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن عبد الله بن أبي قتادة عن أبيه عن النبي ﷺ قال:
إذا بال أحدكم فلا يأخذن ذكره بيمينه ولا يستنج بيمينه ولا يتنفس في الإناء
english_blocks: Muhammad ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Al-Awza‘i related to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from ‘Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who said:
“When one of you urinates, he must not hold his penis with his right hand, cleanse himself with his right hand, or breathe into the vessel.”

arabic_blocks: [154] حدثنا أحمد بن محمد المكي قال: حدثنا عمرو بن يحيى بن سعيد بن عمرو المكي عن جده عن أبي هريرة قال
اتبعت النبي ﷺ وخرج لحاجته فكان لا يلتفت فدنوت منه، فقال ابغني أحجارا أستنفض بها أو نحوه ولا تأتني بعظم ولا روث فأتيته بأحجار بطرف ثيابي فوضعتها إلى جنبه وأعرضت عنه فلما قضى أتبعه بهن
english_blocks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Makki related to us. He said: ‘Amr ibn Yahya ibn Sa‘id ibn ‘Amr al-Makki related to us, from his grandfather, from Abu Hurayrah, who said:

I followed the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, as he went out to relieve himself. He did not turn around. I drew near to him, and he said: “Find me stones with which to cleanse myself.”
Or words to that effect.
“And do not bring me a bone or dung.” I brought him stones in the edge of my garments, placed them beside him and turned away from him. When he had finished, he used them.

arabic_blocks: [155] حدثنا أبو نعيم قال: حدثنا زهير عن أبي إسحاق قال ليس أبو عبيدة ذكره ولكن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود عن أبيه أنه سمع عبد الله يقول
أتى النبي ﷺ الغائط فأمرني أن آتيه بثلاثة أحجار فوجدت حجرين والتمست الثالث فلم أجده فأخذت روثة فأتيته بها فأخذ الحجرين وألقى الروثة، وقال هذا ركس
وقال إبراهيم بن يوسف عن أبيه عن أبي إسحاق حدثني عبد الرحمن
english_blocks: Abu Nu‘aym related to us. He said: Zuhayr related to us, from Abu Ishaq, who said: It was not Abu ‘Ubaydah who mentioned it, but ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad, from his father, that he heard ‘Abdullah saying:

The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went to relieve himself and ordered me to bring him three stones. I found two stones and looked for the third, but could not find it. I took a piece of dung and brought it to him. He took the two stones, threw away the dung, and said: “This is unclean.”
And Ibrahim ibn Yusuf said, from his father, from Abu Ishaq: ‘Abd al-Rahman related to me.
